title: Thermal stress experiment on three Guam corals, March 2025
description:
Dark-adapted photosynthetic efficiency, seawater temperature and illuminance records, and symbiont qPCR data from a seven-day thermal stress experiment on Acropora cf. manni, Pavona decussata and Sclerophytum sp. at the University of Guam Marine Laboratory, March 2025, together with the R scripts that reproduce every figure, table and statistic in the accompanying manuscript.

Code is released under the MIT licence; data and derived results under CC BY 4.0.
